YOUR INFORMATION.

This page explains how information entered on this website is used. For questions about your information, contact Driving Force at info@drivingforce.biz or 021 203 8888.

Finance estimates

The payment calculators run in your browser. An estimate is illustrative, excludes stated fees and insurance, and is not an offer or approval of credit.

Finance applications

The application asks for your contact and identity details, addresses, employment, banking information, income, expenses, declarations and any supporting documents you choose to attach. These details are used to assess and respond to your finance request. Only provide information and documents you are authorised to share.

Who receives your information

When you submit, your application is delivered to Driving Force using VMG’s application delivery service, also used by its EazyFin application. Driving Force may share relevant details with finance providers to consider your request and perform the credit checks you authorise. This website is hosted by Vercel, which processes requests needed to provide the service.

Drafts and documents

Unsubmitted application details stay in the current page and are not saved as a browser draft. Uploaded documents are sent with your application when you submit. Closing or refreshing the page clears the form. Contact Driving Force for information about how submitted applications and documents are retained.

Your choices

Marketing permission is optional. You may ask Driving Force about access to, correction of or deletion of your personal information, or withdraw optional marketing permission. Some records may need to be retained for legal or contractual reasons.
